elements.description: Swaps its content with a soft blur while the box glides to the new size. Change `swapKey` to swap.

properties.name: swapKey
properties.description: Change this to swap – the content that was there fades out, the new content fades in

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Length of the swap in ms

properties.name: blurAmount
properties.description: Blur in px at the start and end of the fade (the React prop `blur`; `blur` is the element's blur() method)

properties.name: morph
properties.description: Which sides glide to the new size; "both" sizes the box to its content

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

props.name: id
props.description: Change this to swap – the children of the old id fade out, the new ones fade in

props.name: children
props.description: The content on show – it swaps whenever `id` changes

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the swap in ms

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur in px at the start and end of the fade

props.name: morph
props.description: Which sides glide to the new size; "both" sizes the box to its content

props.name: as
props.description: The layer element – use span inside buttons and other inline content

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles on the root element
